description: This file defines classes and functions related to managing test fixtures in Playwright, including setup, teardown, and dependency resolution for fixtures within a test worker environment.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Represents a test fixture, managing its setup, teardown, dependencies, and state.

classes.name: FixtureRunner
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of fixtures, including setup, teardown, and parameter resolution for test functions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the fixture, executing its registration function or assigning a static value.

methods.name: _setupInternal
methods.description: Performs internal setup logic, resolving dependencies and invoking the fixture function.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Cleans up the fixture, executing teardown logic and cleaning dependencies.

methods.name: _teardownInternal
methods.description: Performs internal teardown logic, resolving fixture dependencies and cleanup.

methods.name: _collectFixturesInTeardownOrder
methods.description: Collects fixtures in the order needed for teardown based on dependencies.
